card.name: Middle digits inside dose numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a multi-digit number, mostly a dose or strength such as 360 mg or 1600 mcg/mL, just before a final zero or digit. Also fires once on opening triple quotes of a Python docstring.

modes.label: Digit inside dose number
modes.description: A middle digit within a multi-digit dose, strength or amount, usually followed by a trailing 0.
modes.example: Maintenance: 180 mg or 3<<6>>0 mg administered by subcutaneous injection

modes.label: Digit in table values
modes.description: A digit inside a decimal or table figure such as organ dose values.

modes.label: Docstring quotes
modes.description: Opening triple quotes of a docstring in code.
